title: A Changing Land
description: An industrialized gravel pit sits alongside a sea of suburban homes near Draper, Utah, about 20 miles south of Salt Lake City. The photo is part of Victoria Sambunaris's series, "Land Mark," in which she explores the American landscape through the lens of industrialism and infrastructure. The series examines the possibilities and ambitions that have long been associated with the American identity, and how the land around us has been reshaped and transformed—both in good ways and bad—as a result of those ambitions. These photographs will be featured in Sambunaris's latest exhibit at Montclair Art Museum in New Jersey starting June 26, as well as at the Yancey Richardson Gallery in New York City through July 2.
translated_description: 在犹他州德雷珀市（盐湖城以南约20英里）附近，一片工业化砾石坑与郊区住宅的汪洋比邻而立。这张照片出自维多利亚·桑布纳里斯的《地标》系列——她以工业主义与基础设施为棱镜，探索美国大地的风貌。该系列审视了长久以来与美国身份认同紧密相连的种种可能性和雄心壮志，以及这些抱负如何以好坏交织的方式重塑并改变了我们周围的土地。这些作品将于6月26日起在新泽西州蒙特克莱尔艺术博物馆的桑布纳里斯最新个展中亮相，并在纽约扬西·理查森画廊展出至7月2日。
